results.title: The prime minister's state of the nation speech failed to stir even his ...
results.content: ## The Spinoff's Post. ### **The Spinoff**. The prime minister’s state of the nation speech failed to stir even his own party faithful. Read more: https://thespinoff.co.nz/.../luxon-opens-election-year... Luxon opens election year without a spark. ### Luxon opens election year without a spark. No marmite in his sandwich. Wilson Wilson Wilson aye…like a Taylor swift cd on repeat in a Vauxhall. Hey, New Zealand heard Luxon say it as it is. It's as simple as that. What people need to accept is that Ardern Robertson Hipkins and Labour wrecked NZs social and fiscal position so much it will take generations to pay for. The Coalition Government has arrested the decline and is cementing a sustainable future for everyone. So all sizzle, no Sausage? Hard to get excited about word salad! “Mostly, he seemed like a guy who had just got back from holiday and wasn’t quite back into the swing of things.” Says it all really…..
